test_tree_cast: test the tree_cast function that casts all arrays in a JAX tree to a specified dtype
test_tree_cast_like: test the tree_cast_like function that casts arrays in a tree to match the dtypes of a target tree
test_tree_dtype: test the tree_dtype function that returns the common dtype of all arrays in a JAX tree
test_tree_dtype_empty_trees: test the tree_dtype function returns default float32 dtype for empty trees
test_tree_dtype_promote: test the tree_dtype function with promote mode to find the highest common dtype across mixed dtypes
